title: Rabbi Zakkai the Great
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 97:3, Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 7, end of section 4, and Pesikta deRav Kahana 23a. Hyman reports that Tanchuma, Ki Tetze 4, lacks the word “Rabbah.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital passages at Bereshit Rabbah 97:3 and the end of Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:4 have Zakkai Rabbah. The Torat Emet digital Tanchuma, Ki Tetze 4, also includes רבה. Hyman’s report that his Tanchuma reading lacks it is preserved separately; the comparison does not establish the history of the editions. His Pesikta 23a pagination remains unverified.

The whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah 97:3, Shir HaShirim Rabbah at the end of 7:4, and Tanchuma Ki Tetze 4 paragraphs all name Rabbi Zakkai Rabbah. The local full title is supported. Hyman’s report that his Tanchuma lacks Rabbah remains attributed beside the existing note; this digital comparison proves no printed correction history, and his Pesikta 23a pagination remains unverified.
